description: Session 10 retrieval golden set. A retrieved chunk is relevant iff its budget_id is in relevant_budget_ids. Relevant = the budget is a real analogy to estimate the project, not just shared vocabulary. PENDING HUMAN REVIEW: see evals/GOLDEN_SET_REVIEW.md.

queries.query: Online shop for a clothing brand: product listing, shopping cart, checkout where customers pay by card through a payment provider, discount codes and an order confirmation email.
queries.note: TRAP. 005 (headless storefront: catalog, cart/checkout with promotions and payment provider integration) and 017 (bare e-commerce MVP: product list, cart, checkout, order email) are the analogies. BUD-2024-003 (real-time payments gateway: authorization/capture, fraud, settlement, merchant refunds) shares the payment vocabulary but is building the gateway itself, useless to estimate a shop that consumes one. 006 (multi-vendor payouts) and 008 (fashion returns: 'fashion' / 'clothing' overlap) are distractors.

queries.query: Digital lending platform for small businesses: online loan application with KYC and document upload, automated credit risk scoring from bank statements, legally binding e-signature of the contract and periodic reports for the regulator.
queries.note: Only 002 (loan origination: credit scoring, KYC workflow, e-signature, regulatory reporting) is a real analogy; it has 4 chunks so the precision@5 ceiling is 0.80. Distractors: 004 ('risk profiling' of investors), 006 ('KYC' of marketplace vendors), 012 ('regulatory dataset export' for clinical trials), 001 (banking API but no lending).

queries.query: Outpatient clinic app where patients book visits with doctors, receive reminders, join video consultations from home, with records synchronised to the hospital EHR through HL7 FHIR and GDPR consent tracking.
queries.note: Only 009 (FHIR integration, appointment scheduling with reminders, WebRTC telemedicine, consent and audit) matches; 4 chunks so the precision@5 ceiling is 0.80. Distractors: 010 (remote monitoring, healthcare but no scheduling/video), 014 'dock appointment scheduling' and 007 'slot booking' (scheduling vocabulary, other domain).

queries.query: Monitoring of production line machines: collect sensor readings over MQTT into a time-series database, detect anomalies to predict breakdowns before they happen, and surface the alerts in the operators' existing control-room screens.
queries.note: 013 (factory IoT telemetry, predictive maintenance, SCADA dashboard) is the direct analogy; 015 (energy grid: high-volume meter data pipeline + forecasting) is a close industrial telemetry analogy. Borderline, marked NOT relevant: 010 (wearable streams + alerting + dashboard: similar architecture but healthcare/clinical rules). Distractor: 003 'real-time fraud detection' (anomaly vocabulary).

queries.query: Software for a regional distribution centre: stock and picking with barcode scanners, booking time slots for trucks at the loading docks, and planning the delivery routes of the van fleet.
queries.note: 014 (warehouse management core, yard and dock scheduling) and 007 (delivery slot booking, route optimization, inventory sync) together cover the scope. Distractors: 011 (pharmacy inventory and reorder), 008 (warehouse grading of returns), 006 (order fulfillment state machines).
